description: A summary of one long interview or podcast episode Real Alpha cut, found by its YouTube or realalpha.app link, or by words naming it (the show and the guest, or its title): what it covers, the guests and what they do, a point for each part of the conversation with its time, its best minutes in the speaker's own words, the opening of its full analysis, and the page to cite. Use it when someone shares a YouTube link to an AI interview or podcast, or asks to summarize, recap or get the key points of an episode: you can't watch the video, and Real Alpha has listened to it. It covers the episodes Real Alpha cut from the shows it follows; for one it hasn't cut it says so, and how to ask for it.
